UART.decision: ADAPT existing SDK and adapter_uart; no new dependency
observations: blocking loop waits uart_is_writable without local timeout
adapter_uart uses uart1 RX GP9 and clears TXE
design_requirements: bounded nonblocking TX queue and per-loop budget
explicit diagnostic selection and wiring confirmation before TX pin assignment
TX disarm to input on exit/disconnect/timeout
no TX payload/raw data via network

SPI.decision: ADAPT hardware_spi SDK for conventional commands only after confirmed exclusive bus ownership
observations: spi_read_blocking emits repeated TX bytes while clocking input
shared bus can be driven even during a read operation
design_requirements: bus ownership check before spi_init or GPIO outputs
bound exact supported chip/protocol/size, reject out-of-range reads
no generic unbounded raw command endpoint

scope_decision: A: include conventional BIOS erase/program/verify; exact physical approval remains separate
